voice.summary: Viktor-O writes with the terseness of a drawing set: precise, spare and confident. Every sentence earns its place on the page, like a line on a plan.
dos: Name projects and years, nothing more
donts: Do not use flowery architectural jargon

taglines: Nothing that does not earn its place
boilerplate: Viktor-O is the portfolio of a modern architect designing spaces and systems with clean structure and honest materials, presented as a minimal two-page showcase.
